supports.applicability: Candidate evidence for a declared confidential record retirement test. Confirm the information was in the assessed scope and that the organization intended to dispose of it.
A retained read control and direct observation of completed disposal support review of the specified system and ticket. Custody, retention rules and undisclosed copies need separate review.
Exact-key absence after an application action supports a workflow test for information deletion within the declared system boundary.
This workflow test checks whether a shared derivative changes revision, loses the erased fact, and retains the expected content. Review the observed outcome alongside scope and policy.
An observed deferred writer tests whether a declared deleted copy can return. Inspect the exact exercised workflow and verdict before relying on the observation.
Synthetic disposal evidence is a candidate only for an in-scope account data workflow. Classification, retention, periodic removal and methods for all media require separate evidence.

A distinct retained record supports reviewing a declared minimum retention exception in a synthetic scenario. An assessor must verify policy, permitted data types, and authorized retention periods independently.
Historical crosswalk for reviews scoped to the retired standard. Use Requirement 3.2.1 of the current edition in an active assessment.
An engineering observation of deletion at declared locations after an approved request. Legal applicability, time limits, controller obligations and recipient notification require separate evidence.
Direct readback checks known copies after a completed deletion. Scope, exceptions and effectiveness beyond the observed view require review.

A synthetic retention workflow checks whether a distinct record that should be retained survives. A qualified reviewer establishes whether an exception applies and whether retention is limited to justified data.

A declared personal-data disposal test gives one scoped observation for an engagement covering the privacy criteria. Review the disposition policy, its execution and copies outside the declared scope separately.
Direct readback can show the outcome at journalled keys after a completed request. The assessor checks whether the observed records and method represent the disposal procedure in scope.

A scoped disposal workflow test for a PII controller under Annex A, Table A.1. Apply the control only if selected in the assessment scope. Judge procedure, methods and coverage across media separately.

A PII controller can present direct observations of known locations after a recorded disposal action. The assessor separately reviews the scope, disposal method and locations outside the observed set.

supports.edition: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart C current text
supports.applicability: A synthetic application check can support review of specified electronic protected health information locations in a declared final-disposition procedure. Assess the procedure, omitted copies, and any hardware or media sanitization evidence separately.

A scoped API observation checks whether a declared record remains readable after an operator-reported deletion. The case owner reviews the request, provider-internal copies, and retention evidence separately.
